review.reviewer: current Codex assistant, candidate author and explicit source/algorithm reviewer
review.algorithm_assessment: Track cloud position and consecutive dry days for the four country corners. A corner is rained on by exactly one cloud placement; every other cell belongs to at least one corner cloud footprint, so satisfying the four corner drought bounds also satisfies every other field. Precompute age increments/reset transitions, rejecting seven dry days, and use reachable-state DP over the legal same-row/same-column cloud moves and the daily festival exclusions. Start with the mandated central cloud and all corner drought counters equal to one; still reject first-day festival conflicts, as required by the first example.
review.limitations: One source reviewer plus actual isolated tests, not independent dual semantic review.
